label: Bible Study
prompt: _____, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
verse: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
note: The Shema — Israel's great confession, recited daily for millennia, and quoted by Jesus as the first commandment.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well _____.
verse: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
note: God is well pleased with a certain kind of sacrifice: doing good and sharing with others.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two _____, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
verse: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
note: The Samaritan paid the innkeeper two pence and promised to cover the rest — mercy with an open tab.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Let the word of Christ dwell in you _____ in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
verse: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
note: Paul's prescription for church music: let the word move in and teach through psalms, hymns and spiritual songs.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him _____, smitten of God, and afflicted.
verse: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
note: He carried our griefs, yet we thought him 'stricken, smitten of God' — the great misreading of the Servant's suffering.
